replies.request: How do I save this as a layered project?
replies.text:
**How do I save my project and come back later**
1. In Chat Studio, click “Full editor →” to open these Pro controls, then continue with the steps below.
2. Click "Save / Open" in the top toolbar (SPB Projects). It saves the paint (PSD included), every zone and layer settings in one file.
3. To reopen, click "Save / Open" again and load it.
Exact controls: Save / Open (Pro > top toolbar (tool row)); SAVE SHOKK (Pro > left column > ZONES > More (three-dot) menu).

**How do I merge or flatten layers**
1. In Chat Studio, click “Full editor →” to open these Pro controls, then continue with the steps below.
2. LAYERS tab > "Actions".
3. "Merge visible" combines the visible layers (hidden ones survive); "Flatten document" makes one layer and loses separation.
Exact controls: Actions (Pro > right column > LAYERS tab).

replies.request: How can I change only the clearcoat?
replies.text:
**How do I change only one colour of my livery (say all the red)**
1. In Chat Studio, click “Full editor →” to open these Pro controls, then continue with the steps below.
2. Your selected zone is "Roof recoloured red" (zone 1) - click another card in the ZONES list to work on that one instead.
3. Click "+ Add Zone".
4. In COLOR click "PICK COLOR FROM CAR", then click a red spot on the car. Raise the tolerance if red edges are left.
5. In BASE pick a finish.
6. To make it a different colour set the BASE COLOR dropdown to "Use solid color" and c

replies.request: How do I keep the current paint when making the roof chrome?
replies.text:
**How do I make something chrome**
1. In Chat Studio, click “Full editor →” to open these Pro controls, then continue with the steps below.
2. Your selected zone is "Roof recoloured red" (zone 1) - click another card in the ZONES list to work on that one instead.
3. Select the zone, BASE > Base Material > Chrome (mirror) or Satin Chrome (softer).
4. Chrome repaints the zone silver. To keep your colours and only get the shine, use a Foundation chrome with "Use source paint (spec only)".
5. In iRacing the paint under a metal part should be near w

replies.request: How do I find the number layer?
replies.text:
For the numbers: you want clean edges and no glare. Your body is Gloss (high gloss). Avoid chrome, glitter and colour-shifting finishes on numbers: they break up the digit edges at speed. Swatches are shown on your car's colour.
